purpose: Teach: 楓/出逢い/隠れ家/どんぐり/硬貨/大砲/散髪/ブルーベリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと楓の紅葉を見に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go see the autumn maples in the park together, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, unhurried invitation. Gentle smile in the voice. Slight lilt upward on the question, inviting but not pushing. The tone of someone offering a small gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママとの出逢いの話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard the story about how you met my mom.
lines.style: Bright, direct, eager to show he's been listening. Clear, unguarded delivery—a child delighted by a secret. Slight rush forward, like he can't quite contain the excitement of sharing what he knows.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの仕事場は隠れ家のように落ち着くのよ
lines.en: Your workplace is so calm and tucked away, Sho. Like a little hideaway.
lines.style: Soft, reflective, almost to herself. Slow pace. Gazing inward slightly. The tone of someone noticing beauty in something ordinary and wanting to share that observation gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園でどんぐりを拾ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I found acorns in the park today!
lines.style: Bright, direct report. Quick pace. Genuine, unperformed enthusiasm—the simple joy of a six-year-old sharing a small discovery. No artifice, just delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが古い硬貨を見せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Grandpa's going to show you his old coins, you know. Isn't that lovely?
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly musing. Gentle pace. The inflection of someone delighted on Sho's behalf. Trailing softly at the end, letting the thought settle rather than push.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で大砲を見たよ
lines.en: I saw a cannon at the museum, Mei-sis!
lines.style: Excited, direct report. Quick upward lilt at the end. A child sharing something impressive he's learned. Unguarded energy, wanting her to understand how interesting this was.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが散髪に行かれたわね、すっきりされてるわ
lines.en: Your dad looks so fresh and neat now that he's had his hair cut.
lines.style: Warm observation, approving. Light, easy delivery. The tone of noticing something small and genuine about someone you care for. A quiet compliment wrapped in casual observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんとブルーベリージャム作ったよ
lines.en: I made blueberry jam with my mom, Mei-sis!
lines.style: Proud, glowing report. Clear, unhurried pace. A child sharing an accomplishment, wanting her to see the good thing he and his mother made together. Open-hearted and slightly breathless with pride.
